item.title: FTC issues warnings to rental software firms on price transparency
item.description: FTC targets rental software firms for failing to disclose all fees, citing consumer harm and possible legal action.

item.title: Blue Owl commits $2.5B in funds to Point’s home equity investment platform
item.description: The new capital will allow Palo Alto, California-based Point to originate about $10 billion in HEIs over the next three years.

item.title: CrossCountry challenges court order in Gallo mortgage fraud case
item.description: CrossCountry Mortgage seeks to vacate a court order blocking its arbitration claim against Christopher Gallo as it aims to recover a $2.1M bonus.

item.title: Zillow updates sites, apps after watchdog flags ad disclosure gaps
item.description: Zillow Group undertook an extensive assessment of its digital properties and coordinated with the watchdog on addressing each compliance gap.

item.title: New York raises senior property tax exemption to 65%
item.description: Under the new law, localities now have the option to offer exemptions of up to 65% of a home's value for seniors who fall below the maximum income eligibility thresholds set at the local level.

item.title: Mortgage delinquencies steady in September, but there’s ‘signs of stress beneath the surface’
item.description: U.S. mortgage delinquencies held at 3% in September 2025, but rising foreclosure rates highlight growing borrower challenges.

item.title: As rural housing costs soar, financing affordable housing remains a hurdle
item.description: Rural affordable housing development is hindered by limited financing options. Lenders and investors often overlook smaller rural projects, only widening the affordability gap.

item.title: Coalition presses for stronger federal flood response, eyes ROAD to Housing Act
item.description: Leaders said the coalition began forming after the catastrophic July 2022 floods in eastern Kentucky and southwestern Virginia.

item.title: Stress appears for consumer credit conditions
item.description: AFSA's Q3 report reveals a dip in consumer credit conditions, but lenders remain optimistic about future economic conditions.

item.title: Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate details 2026 homebuyer trends
item.description: The brand will also release an Agent Playbook designed to show how to use these trends to better position listings and guide clients.
